title: Add expert-annotated PANORAMA lesions: does more positive training data improve outlining?
authority: October12 user explicitly approved excluding five uncertain development scans, documenting the exploratory policy, loading data and launching when ready. Governing amendment PANORAMA-EXPLORATORY-ADMISSION-20261012.md replaces broad image-overlap gating for this run only. Production checks must still pass.
parent: CAP-EXP-016: PanTS-only long run: recover the course recipe before adding PANORAMA
question: At the same 24000-update budget and checkpoint-selection rule, does adding admitted expert-PDAC PANORAMA training subjects improve native PanTS development lesion Dice without material detection or false-alarm deterioration?

hypotheses.H0: The practical PANORAMA-positive addition has no improvement in native positive-case macro Dice relative to the PanTS-only selected model (delta <= 0).
hypotheses.H1: The practical PANORAMA-positive addition improves native positive-case macro Dice (delta > 0).
hypotheses.practical_success: Observed Dice delta >= 0.02 and paired 95% interval lower bound > 0, with all point-estimate guardrails passing.
hypotheses.limitations: This tests an addition block: additional expert-positive studies, PDAC-specific source/annotation distribution, increased positive sampling fraction, and a declared PANORAMA union-ROI adapter. Undeclared overlap and SuPreM membership remain uncertain; unique cross-source patient count is not proven. It does not isolate sample count, prove an ensemble benefit, or establish independent holdout generalization. Bootstrap intervals do not include training-seed or checkpoint-selection variability.

fixed_recipe.architecture: Same three-class SegResNet/SuPreM as parent; same original weights hash and head initialization
fixed_recipe.sampler: Same full-cohort seeded permutation algorithm, once per selected training member per pass; no extra oversampling or class weighting. PANORAMA changes membership, positive proportion and exact draw order. Log source/class/subject exposures.
fixed_recipe.budget: 24000 updates, not equal epochs. At maximum cohort approximately14.31 passes rather than18.00; fewer PanTS-only exposures is an explicit coupled change. No automatic duration or update extension.
fixed_recipe.inputs: PanTS cache byte-identical. PANORAMA uses existing separately qualified 144-cubed physical-RAS pancreas-plus-lesion union support to avoid dropping expert PDAC outside machine pancreas. Same HU window and target precedence; source-aware identity required. No crop-policy change to PanTS or its evaluation.
fixed_recipe.mapping: PANORAMA publisher pancreas code4 -> target1; PDAC code1 -> target2 with lesion precedence; all other valid source codes -> background0. Source storage may be exact-valued integer or float; unknown/fractional/nonfinite labels fail.
fixed_recipe.eval_and_retention: Validation every2000; checkpoint every500; retain8000,24000,initial,latest,best with independent backup; same earliest-tie highest positive tensor Dice selection. Twelve scheduled selection opportunities in each completed arm.

evaluation.primary: Native patient-macro lesion Dice on the36 retained positive PanTS development cases, including zero-overlap and outside-crop references; treatment selected-best versus parent selected-best, bothselected andscored on the same70-case subset.
evaluation.selection_fairness: Neither terminal treatment versus selected control nor selected treatment versus terminal control is the primary comparison. Final24k versus final24k is a mandatory secondary robustness comparison, not a fallback route to acceptance.
evaluation.inference: Frozen native evaluator, three-class argmax, no TTA, thresholds, cleanup or largest-component pruning
evaluation.detection: Case any-overlap and26-connected native reference-component detection; report both
evaluation.empty_behavior: Any predicted lesion on34 retained reference-empty cases; volume and component burden; pre-existing50mm3 alert secondary only
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired patient bootstrap10000 resamples, seed20261012, percentile95% interval. Retain paired gains/losses and fixed reference membership. One training seed only; development-selected models and repeated-use cohort imply selection optimism and exploratory generalization limits.
evaluation.accept: Primary delta>=0.02 AND primary CI lower>0 AND all guardrail point estimates pass. Label as accepted development intervention, not release promotion or clinically acceptable false-alarm performance.
evaluation.reject: Any guardrail breach OR primary Dice CI upper<0.02 at a valid completed horizon.
evaluation.inconclusive: Other valid results; do not call failure to reject H0 acceptance of H0.
evaluation.invalid_or_operational: Leakage/incorrect mapping/identity mismatch is invalid; interrupted/resource-failed run is incomplete or operationally_failed, not scientific rejection.
evaluation.subgroups: Native case-total lesion volume <1cm3,1-10cm3,>10cm3; component-wise outcomes; case-wise Dice gains/losses; source/phase only where verified metadata exists. Tiny subgroups are descriptive.
evaluation.ensemble_followup: Only propose a separate ensemble experiment if paired errors are complementary and a preregistered combination/calibration plan preserves detection while reducing alarms. Neither a Dice gain nor averaging these two models alone proves complementarity. No fitting a gate on the reused development cases and presenting its score as independent validation.
